source_database_contract: Frozen SQLite v7; read and snapshot issued references only. No ALTER of the old schema.
actual_use_admission: A separate explicit use record is required; documentary import never asserts use, EvidenceItem or EvidenceReferenceRole. Grounding existence/structure is checked; factual adequacy still needs justified review.
identity_policy: Unique use ID and unique exact reference/item/context/grounding-version/purpose tuple in this slice. Duplicate descriptions under different grounding identities require wider identity adjudication.
relational_profile: Append-only candidate snapshot plus explicit grounded-use records. Corrections, temporal reconciliation and production deployment are outside this packet.
rdf_scope: Each use is a version-qualified graph. Auxiliary version pins, grounding text/locator and decision metadata use candidate EU vocabulary, not new native relations.
